description:
Add two new low-level primitives to Filament.Hooks. These are called only by compiler-generated code, not directly by users.

## memo_at/3

  @spec memo_at(slot :: non_neg_integer() | {atom(), non_neg_integer()}, deps :: [term()], factory :: (-> term())) :: term()

Direct slot read/write with an explicit compile-time-assigned key. No auto-increment. Equivalent to use_memo/2 but takes an explicit index instead of using hook_index. The {:t, N} tuple key namespace keeps template slots separate from explicit hook slots (use_state, use_observable, etc.).

## event_at/2

  @spec event_at(slot :: non_neg_integer(), handler :: function()) :: wire_ref :: String.t()

Registers an event handler at a specific slot index. Returns the wire-ref string in the same format as register_event_handler/1. N is a compile-time literal.

## Slot key changes

hook_slots is already a map — extend it to accept {:t, N} tuple keys alongside plain integers. No migration needed for existing fibers.

## Acceptance

- memo_at({:t, 0}, [], fn -> :value end) returns :value on first call, reuses it on subsequent calls with same deps
- event_at(0, fn -> :action end) registers handler at slot 0 and returns wire ref
- use_state and use_observable slots (plain integers) are unaffected
- No new processes or global state
title: flm-o58.1: Add memo_at/3 and event_at/2 to hooks.ex; {:t,N} slot key support
